items.prompt: Evaluate \(\frac{3}{4}+\frac{1}{6}\). Give your answer as a fraction in its simplest form.
items.scheme: M1 Choose a common denominator. M1 Add correctly adjusted numerators. A1 Fully simplified fraction.

items.prompt: A right-angled triangle has perpendicular sides \(3\text{ cm}\) and \(4\text{ cm}\). Find its hypotenuse.
